_doc: Eastward shared colors (used by 15-75% of 220 sprites; together a median 59% of each sprite's pixels). letter -> [hex variants, role]. Used by tools/refs.py text --map.
b: shadow brown: mouths, beard/hair shadow, leather, deep folds
d: deep skin / red-brown: lips, nostrils, dark blush
s: skin shadow: nose shape, sockets, jaw, blush, cast shadow under hair
W: cream highlight: teeth, eye whites, hair/cloth highlight
g: muted olive-grey cloth / grey hair shadow
